ale_3.7_2: The quartermaster asked Bastian Ale to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Bastian Ale could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Bastian Ale tried to fold a frozen groundsheet. It objected loudly enough to wake the next sleeper. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bastian Ale helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
always_out_front: Roland Front came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Roland Front kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Roland Front brought back a wounded man and a lost machine gun from the Brickworks in one trip. He is Lance Corporal now. After the loss of Grey Mill, Roland Front helped stack spare sandbags at T-S9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
buff_kitty85: On Day 5 Hugo Kitty took a post at S-F22 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He can fall asleep anywhere, instantly, and the men liked him for it.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Hugo Kitty tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F22 is up. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Hill 304 is lost. Hugo Kitty heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Hugo Kitty fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Albin Weyer, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

At Hill 304, Hugo Kitty and Ivo "Bones" Rylan exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet clipped Hugo Kitty's helmet at S-F22 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Rafael Broadshoulde of the Hegemony (@broadshoulderedbastard). Dawn watch. Hugo Kitty put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian "Crow" Jwger, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept S-F22. Hugo Kitty took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Cyril Miller of the Hegemony (@ryder_miller11). Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medics called Hugo Kitty 'the corridor man', because he lay there so long. Today the corridor is empty. Hugo Kitty is back on the line. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Hugo Kitty wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo Kitty. Hugo Kitty read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A round came through the loophole Hugo Kitty was watching at S-F22 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420). Hugo Kitty saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Wendel "Whistle" Gonzo, badly wounded. Hugo Kitty was killed at S-F22 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420).

Another member of the House of Kitty reached the line: Silas Kitty. He asked where Hugo Kitty had slept, then chose a different corner. The clerk counted the names twice. Silas Kitty is number 349 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Silas Kitty watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
cesare_borgia5076: Viktor "Crow" Borgia came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Viktor "Crow" Borgia was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at Q-F14. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul of the Concord (@shimmapaul). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Viktor "Crow" Borgia folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Viktor "Crow" Borgia walked back up the communication trench to Q-F14, slower than before, but on his own feet. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Viktor "Crow" Borgia watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
david_mtzrn: After 9 days of war, Q-F17 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Isidor Mtzrn.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Isidor Mtzrn watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The bread had frozen at the edges. Isidor Mtzrn held it near the stove and defended the space with both elbows. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Isidor Mtzrn wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
dooka_the_shitter: Nobody asked Wendel Shitter why he came. Nobody in P-F1 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

Wendel Shitter has learned to recognize the ration cart by its squeaky wheel. This afternoon, a different squeak caused real disappointment. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Wendel Shitter wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
emotionless_android: On Day 10, Arno "Brick" Android arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Arno "Brick" Android and Norbert Cheese argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. A letter from home reached Arno "Brick" Android before dusk. Arno "Brick" Android read it twice and slept a little easier. Arno "Brick" Android asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Arno "Brick" Android folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
jawir_edgy_irony_media: Dorian Media reported to R-S17 with a book with the last pages torn out sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Dorian Media of the Concord lobbed a tin of jam over the wire at the Hanging Bridge. It came back empty, washed, with a flower inside and Ulrich "Hollow" Mathias's name scratched on the lid.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Dorian Media heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Dorian Media ran a message through the communication trench under shellfire. The message said: 'Hold.' A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dorian Media is number 596. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dorian Media watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
jcsv2305: Casimir Jcsv came up on Day 9 carrying news from Port Abel. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A bullet struck Casimir Jcsv below the ribs at R-R9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Konrad Daami of the Concord (@daami_nt). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Casimir Jcsv helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Casimir Jcsv lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. A letter from home reached Casimir Jcsv before dusk. Casimir Jcsv read it twice and slept a little easier. Casimir Jcsv got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 991. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Casimir Jcsv did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
lelio_benvenuti: Day 11: Henrik Benvenuti reached U-F4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Henrik Benvenuti folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
m0c_sam0: Ulrich "Smokes" Sam came up the line with a frozen apple and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Ulrich "Smokes" Sam saw Silas Kmec freeze up on the fire step at the Brickworks. Smokes said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.

Night raid. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Ulrich "Smokes" Sam could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.

Ulrich "Smokes" Sam tells terrible jokes. Today, under fire at the Brickworks, that habit was the only steady thing in S-S2. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich "Smokes" Sam. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam is number 601 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Ulrich "Smokes" Sam watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
mugginsthedestroyer: Emil "Button" Mugginsthede arrived on Day 9 as a replacement. The men in R-C6 had been fighting for 9 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Emil "Button" Mugginsthede came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot. News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Emil "Button" Mugginsthede during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

The medic looked at Emil "Button" Mugginsthede's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-C6. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil "Button" Mugginsthede. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede answered to number 646. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Emil "Button" Mugginsthede helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
qhmullaney: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Hugo "Lucky" Ayangd, grazed. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-R6, Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney is number 880. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R6. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney has learned to walk bent double.
simplepach_wt: Day 9: Gustav Simplepach reached S-R4 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Gustav Simplepach read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Gustav Simplepach's ear at S-R4 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Valentin "Shadow" Castlecrashe of the Hegemony (@castlecrasher1). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Simplepach is number 956. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill is lost. Gustav Simplepach heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
strikafrom_lusaka: Casimir "Owl" Lusaka, a shepherd from Rosenau, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in Q-F18. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Casimir "Owl" Lusaka wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

The gun team argued about who carried the heaviest load. Casimir "Owl" Lusaka offered to swap loads. The argument ended at once. After the loss of Grey Mill, Casimir "Owl" Lusaka helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
warhamster4: The draft reached S-F18 on Day 3. Albin Warhamster was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A clear shot from S-F18. Albin Warhamster grazed Emil Ghostbebrii and slid back down below the parapet. Now serving as a sniper, Albin Warhamster discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Albin Warhamster went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-F18 is closed now. Albin Warhamster fired at a movement across the wire at S-F18. The man went down: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla, badly wounded. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close. Hill 304 is lost. Albin Warhamster heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Albin Warhamster dreamt he was back in Ashford Vale, working as a postman. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Jakub Lilsaint of the Hegemony (@carlos_lilsaint_). A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.

Albin Warhamster's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it. A letter from home found Albin Warhamster before the night shift. Albin Warhamster folded it small and kept it close.
Face blackened with soot, Albin Warhamster spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki was gravely wounded.

Albin Warhamster threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong was down and screaming for a medic. (@dinhdong234) The Hegemony sentry, Jakub Lilsaint, shouted once. Albin Warhamster silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@carlos_lilsaint_) A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at S-F18. Albin Warhamster was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Jakub Lilsaint of the Hegemony (@carlos_lilsaint_).

A letter came with Rafael Warhamster: "I am Albin Warhamster's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The new duty roster listed Rafael Warhamster as a machine gunner. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

Rafael Warhamster had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Emil Ghostbebrii crossed it, Rafael Warhamster fired. Emil Ghostbebrii was badly wounded. A letter from home found Rafael Warhamster before the night shift. Rafael Warhamster folded it small and kept it close. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Rafael Warhamster answered to number 198. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Rafael Warhamster read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
